title: SettingsRefusal
description: Body of a refused settings request. Nothing was written.

message.description: What went wrong, as one sentence.

problems.description: Every rejected value with its key, when values were the cause; empty otherwise.

revision.description: The file's revision now, when it changed since the request's revision was read.

FieldError.description: A value of the configuration outside what it allows: its key and what it must be.

key.description:
The value's dotted key, such as `admission.headroom_pct`, `presets.big.min_cores` or
`classifier.rules[2].program`. A preset's name is reported as `presets.<name>`.

message.description: What the value must be, such as `must be at least 0 and below 100`.

Revision.description: A version of `config.toml`'s bytes, as 16 hex digits.
